scope: Layered TOML config loader (Loader API surface) + workflow preference resolver, overnight gate system, axiom layer, elevation proposer, and follow-up namespace (Workflow Resolver + [followup] + [axioms] surface). Formerly split as `config-design` (slice-1) and `config` (slice-2); merged into one concept.

entry_points.summary: [Loader API] Built-in default values for all config keys including [workflow], [followup], [axioms], [brainstorm], and [experiment] sections (layer 1)
[Loader API] Allowed enum sets per dotted-key; hard-fail on repo/env, soft-warn on global; covers workflow, followup, axioms, brainstorm, experiment keys
[Loader API] Build resolved config from all 4 layers; returns (values, sources) dicts
[Loader API] Resolve and print single dotted-key value; exits 3 on unknown or meta key
[Loader API] Resolve multiple keys in one process; output JSON object {key: value}; unknown/meta keys -> null + stderr; always exits 0
[Loader API] Print export lines for all user knobs; emit config_resolved event once per run
[Loader API] Write global config with defaults + inline comments if absent; never overwrites
[Loader API] Print effective value and source layer for one key
[Loader API] List of env-only knob names (Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK, Z_HARNESS_OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE_EFFECTIVE, Z_HARNESS_ASK_ALL, etc.) surfaced by inspect-all; not settable via TOML
[Loader API] Print all config knobs with value/source/persistence_class; covers TOML keys, question_ids, env-only knobs; --json for machine-parseable output; exits 0
[Loader API] Print yes|no for a given event kind; always exits 0; exits 2 on unknown event. Valid kinds: approval, phase_end, error
[Loader API] Thin bash wrapper: exec python3 scripts/config.py $@

[Workflow Resolver] Single source of truth for AskUserQuestion routing-class preference keys: workflow.audit_to_amend, workflow.slug_confirm, workflow.implement_all_proceed, workflow.review_all_proceed, workflow.plan_decisions_approval, workflow.spec_retro_discovery; validated against VALIDATORS at module load
[Workflow Resolver] Default overnight allowlist: {workflow.slug_confirm: recommend_derived, workflow.audit_to_amend: amend}; merged with Z_HARNESS_OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE_EFFECTIVE
[Workflow Resolver] Maps (question_id, option-domain-value) -> resolver result-domain (skip|prefill|ask|halt|defer-to-sink)
[Workflow Resolver] Module-load consistency check: asserts QUESTION_IDS <= VALIDATORS and RESULT_MAP references only valid choices; raises SystemExit(2) on violation
[Axiom Layer] Dynamically load scripts/axiom-store.py (hyphen in filename prevents normal import); cached per process; returns None when store absent or fails to import
[Axiom Layer] Load graph-valid approved axioms for a question_id; gated on axioms.enabled; returns [] when disabled, store absent, or graph validation fails
[Workflow Resolver] Pre-axiom resolution: config + routing-pref memory; returns 7-tuple (envelope, emit_result, emit_source, emit_strength, exit_code, resolved_value, memory_silent)
[Workflow Resolver] Full resolver: apply axiom layer on top of config+memory envelope; agree/gap-fill/direct-conflict axiom outcomes; returns 5-tuple
[Workflow Resolver] Post-process resolution envelope for Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt; swaps ask->overnight_decision (allowlist hit) or ask->halt (not in allowlist); exits 5 on ASK_ALL+NO_ASK conflict
[Workflow Resolver] Parse Z_HARNESS_OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE_EFFECTIVE JSON; merge over OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE_QIDS_DEFAULT; drop malformed entries with routing_preference_malformed event
[Workflow Resolver] Walk docs/llm/*.json for routing-preference entries matching question_id; respects scope (global|project); skips INDEX.json and malformed entries
[Workflow Resolver] Merge memory match list: highest strength wins on agreement; returns (None, 'conflict', sources) when entries disagree
[Workflow Resolver] Consult 4-layer config + memory + axioms + overnight overrides; return JSON {result, default, source, rule_id, strength, reason, sources[]}; stdout reserved for JSON
[Workflow Resolver] Lightweight overnight-gate checker; returns {result: halt|proceed|unhandled_gate, question_id, rule_id}; policy mode aborts loud on registered gate not covered by frozen policy
[Workflow Resolver] Atomically write a TOML key to global or project config via tmp+rename; validates against VALIDATORS before writing; exit 2 on invalid value; exit 0 silently on success
[Workflow Resolver] Print sorted JSON array of registered question IDs; consumed by /z-suggest-memory for routing-preference validation
[Loader API] Rewrite old provider names (codex, gemini, claude) in roles.*.runtime to -cli suffixed form; applied to global + project layers; idempotent; exits 4 on I/O error
[Workflow Resolver] Walk metrics.jsonl for repeated command-pair patterns; emit JSON proposal if threshold met; never writes — caller owns write

invariants: [Loader API] schema_version must equal 1 (else exit 2)
[Loader API] ensure-defaults never writes repo-local; only writes the global user path
[Loader API] should-notify always exits 0 on valid event kind (yes|no on stdout); exits 2 on unknown event
[Loader API] config_resolved event emitted at most once per $Z_HARNESS_RUN via O_EXCL temp-file de-dup
[Loader API] slice-1 enums: notify.level in {off, approval_only, all}; docs.always_apply in {always, never}
[Loader API] transliteration rule: dotted.key -> Z_HARNESS_<SECTION>_<KEY> (uppercase, dot to underscore)
[Loader API] keys must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$; hyphens or >2-level nesting exit 2
[Loader API] empty env vars are treated as missing (not as override)
[Loader API] unknown keys in TOML files are silently ignored for forward compatibility
[Loader API] global-layer enum violations: soft-warn + fall back to default; repo/env-layer violations: exit 2
[Loader API] valid should-notify event kinds: approval, phase_end, error — any other value exits 2
[Loader API] get-batch always exits 0; unknown/meta keys -> null in output + stderr warning (never exit 3)
[Loader API] inspect-all always exits 0 on success; covers DEFAULTS keys + QUESTION_IDS + ENV_ONLY_KNOBS
[axioms] axioms.enabled valid values: true | false; default true
[axioms] axioms.kernel_budget_chars valid values: positive integer (>=1); default 6000
[axioms] axioms.extract_min_recurrence valid values: positive integer (>=1); default 3
[axioms] axioms.auto_extract_post_run valid values: true | false; default true
[axioms] Z_HARNESS_AXIOMS_ENABLED, Z_HARNESS_AXIOMS_KERNEL_BUDGET_CHARS, Z_HARNESS_AXIOMS_EXTRACT_MIN_RECURRENCE, Z_HARNESS_AXIOMS_AUTO_EXTRACT_POST_RUN are the env transliterations
[axioms] axioms.enabled=false causes _load_axiom_matches to return [] immediately; envelope is byte-identical to pre-axiom result (no axiom key added)
[axioms] axiom layer is lowest precedence: config and memory always win; axiom only fills a gap (config at default AND memory silent)
[axioms] axiom source values: 'axiom' (gap-fill), 'axiom_conflict' (higher layer disagrees; higher layer wins value/result/strength)
[axioms] agree outcome: axiom appended to sources[] only; no source/result/strength change and NO nested axiom object
[axioms] gap-fill outcome: source='axiom', strength='soft', axiom:{id, statement} nested object present (no conflict key)
[axioms] direct-conflict outcome: source='axiom_conflict', higher layer wins value/result/strength, axiom:{id, statement, conflict:true} nested
[axioms] axiom-store.py is loaded dynamically (hyphen in filename); absent store returns [] silently
[axioms] only graph-valid (validate_graph ok=true) approved records participate; corrupt active set -> no axiom participates
[experiment] experiment.persona_rotation valid values: true | false; default true
[experiment] experiment.control_every_n valid values: positive integer; default 5
[experiment] Z_HARNESS_EXPERIMENT_PERSONA_ROTATION and Z_HARNESS_EXPERIMENT_CONTROL_EVERY_N are the env transliterations
[experiment] experiment.persona_rotation = false is a complete no-op: no draw events, no state files, no PERSONA_PREFIX, no persona_attempt_outcome
[experiment] control counter persisted at .z-harness/.persona-control-counter (repo-level, flock-guarded)
[brainstorm] brainstorm.personas valid values: true | false; default true
[brainstorm] Z_HARNESS_BRAINSTORM_PERSONAS is the env transliteration (mechanical rule: brainstorm.personas -> Z_HARNESS_BRAINSTORM_PERSONAS)
[brainstorm] brainstorm.personas = false is a no-op for all non-brainstorm commands; only gates /z-brainstorm persona diversity
[brainstorm] repo/env layer violations exit 2 (hard fail); global layer violations soft-warn and fall back to default (true)
[Workflow Resolver] workflow.audit_to_amend valid values: ask | amend | stop; default ask
[Workflow Resolver] workflow.slug_confirm valid values: ask | auto_accept | recommend_derived; default ask
[Workflow Resolver] workflow.implement_all_proceed valid values: ask | auto_resume | halt; default ask
[Workflow Resolver] workflow.review_all_proceed valid values: ask | proceed | halt; default ask
[Workflow Resolver] workflow.plan_decisions_approval valid values: ask | approve | halt; default ask
[Workflow Resolver] workflow.spec_retro_discovery valid values: ask | defer_to_sink_p2; default ask

Z_HARNESS_WORKFLOW_AUDIT_TO_AMEND, Z_HARNESS_WORKFLOW_SLUG_CONFIRM, Z_HARNESS_WORKFLOW_IMPLEMENT_ALL_PROCEED, Z_HARNESS_WORKFLOW_REVIEW_ALL_PROCEED, Z_HARNESS_WORKFLOW_PLAN_DECISIONS_APPROVAL, Z_HARNESS_WORKFLOW_SPEC_RETRO_DISCOVERY are the env transliterations
resolve-question stdout is reserved exclusively for JSON; all diagnostics route to stderr
Z_HARNESS_ASK_ALL=1 short-circuits resolve-question to always return {result: ask, source: override}
Z_HARNESS_EXPLAIN_RESOLUTION=1 or --explain flag prints a human-readable resolution trace on stderr

resolve-question exit 0 = valid JSON; exit 2 = bad invocation; exit 3 = unknown question_id (JSON with error key still emitted); exit 4 = I/O error (JSON still emitted); exit 5 = config conflict (ASK_ALL=1 + NO_ASK=halt)
QUESTION_IDS registry is the single source of truth; _run_startup_guards() asserts set(QUESTION_IDS) <= set(VALIDATORS) at module load
RESULT_MAP result domain is skip|prefill|ask|halt|defer-to-sink; defer-to-sink routes question context to scripts/sink-add.sh instead of presenting AskUserQuestion
Resolver is read-only — never writes to config or memory; all writes go through config.py set or /z-suggest-memory
Conflict tier always returns result: ask; sources[] is always populated with both disagreeing entries
config.py set writes atomically via tmp+rename; validates against VALIDATORS before writing; exits 0 silently on success (no stdout output); exit 2 on invalid value
propose-prefs.py never writes automatically; proposal fires AskUserQuestion and user picks the write target
Proposer suppression is scoped to (project_root, question_id) stored in .z-harness/.propose-suppress; suppression expires after 30 days
Z_HARNESS_PROPOSE_WINDOW_S controls max gap (seconds) between command A end and B start for pattern detection; default 3600
Z_HARNESS_PROPOSE_THRESHOLD controls min repetitions to propose; default 3
Z_HARNESS_PROPOSE_MAX_RUNS controls number of recent run_start events to scan; default 30
routing-preference memory entries live in docs/llm/workflow.json (global scope) or docs/llm/workflow-<project-slug>.json (project scope)
[Overnight gate] Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt activates overnight mode; _apply_overnight_overrides post-processes every resolve-question envelope
[Overnight gate] Z_HARNESS_ASK_ALL=1 + Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt are mutually exclusive; resolve-question exits 5 on conflict
[Overnight gate] OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE_QIDS_DEFAULT = {workflow.slug_confirm: recommend_derived, workflow.audit_to_amend: amend}
[Overnight gate] Z_HARNESS_OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE_EFFECTIVE (JSON object) is merged over defaults; env wins on key collision; malformed JSON causes env layer to be skipped
[Overnight gate] check-no-ask fails closed: unregistered question_id with NO_ASK=halt -> halt + unknown_ask_blocked event
[Overnight gate] check-no-ask in policy mode (NO_ASK=halt + AUTODECIDE_EFFECTIVE set): registered gate not covered by policy -> unhandled_gate (loud abort + event), not plain halt
[Overnight gate] check-no-ask always exits 0 on valid invocations; exits 2 only on argparse error
[followup] followup.default_sink valid values: project | global; default project
[followup] followup.notion_enabled valid values: true | false; default false
[followup] followup.auto_close_low_risk_enabled valid values: true | false; default TRUE (on by default — kill-switch is enabled)
[followup] followup.staleness_hard_dismiss_days = 0 means disabled; must be set to a positive int to activate auto-dismiss
[followup] Array-typed followup keys (path_allowlist, path_denylist, audit_evidence_required_artifacts) are not in VALIDATORS; accepted as-is by the TOML parser
[followup] auto_close_low_risk_path_denylist last entry is '/*.md' (root-anchored) not '*.md' (any depth); leading slash restricts to top-level only
[followup] Z_HARNESS_NOTION_TOKEN is env-only (not a TOML key); read by notion-push.py _resolve_token() before falling back to secrets.toml; never log it

[active-plan] Z_HARNESS_EXTERNAL_DEFAULT, Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR, Z_HARNESS_REGISTRY_ENABLED, Z_HARNESS_REGISTRY_STALE_SECS, Z_HARNESS_STRICT_OVERLAP are NOT in config.py DEFAULTS/VALIDATORS; consumed by plan-path.sh and active-plan-registry.py only
gotchas: [axioms] axioms.enabled=false gates ALL axiom participation including auto_extract_post_run; both must be re-enabled separately if desired
[axioms] axioms.kernel_budget_chars and axioms.extract_min_recurrence must be positive integers; string '0' fails validation (positive means >=1)
[axioms] axiom-store.py is loaded via importlib (not normal import) because the filename has a hyphen; module load failures are silently tolerated — axioms just don't participate
[axioms] axioms never override config or memory; agree/conflict outcomes leave value/result unchanged; only gap-fill changes the result
[experiment] Global layer experiment.* violations are soft (warn + default); repo/env layer violations exit 2 (hard fail)
[Loader API] Global config validation is soft (warn + default fallback); repo/env config validation is hard (exit 2) — same bad value has different outcomes depending on which file it appears in
[Loader API] docs.always_apply=never only suppresses doc-fetcher in light flows (/z-do); heavy flows always dispatch doc-fetcher regardless
[Loader API] Z_HARNESS_REPO_CONFIG env var overrides git-root discovery entirely — exits 2 if path does not exist
[Loader API] ensure-defaults exits 4 (not 2) on I/O errors and when file exists but is empty or unparseable; it never silently overwrites
[Loader API] scripts/config.sh is only a 2-line exec wrapper — all logic lives in config.py
[Loader API] Empty env vars (Z_HARNESS_NOTIFY_LEVEL=) are treated as missing, not as overrides
[Loader API] cmd_set exits 0 silently on success — no stdout output; do not parse stdout from cmd_set
[Loader API] Valid event kinds for should-notify: approval, phase_end, error only. Passing run_complete (used in some callers e.g. z-research) exits 2; guard invocations with || true if needed
[Loader API] get-batch always exits 0 unlike get which exits 3 on unknown keys — callers must check for null values in JSON output to detect missing keys
[Workflow Resolver] workflow.slug_confirm value domain (ask/auto_accept/recommend_derived) is NOT the same as the resolver result domain (ask/prefill/skip); RESULT_MAP translates between them
auto_accept resolves to result: skip (silently accept derived slug); recommend_derived resolves to result: prefill (pre-select derived slug in AskUser)
Slug-confirm retrofit has TWO gates: hard collision check (always runs, resolver NOT consulted) + soft non-obvious confirmation (resolver-controlled). resolve-question only governs the soft gate
resolve-question error paths (exit 2/3/4) must always fall through to ask — never silently skip
Capture exit code separately from output: RESOLVED=$(python3 scripts/config.py resolve-question ...); RESOLVE_EXIT=$?. Do NOT pipe through set -e chains that swallow the exit code
When source==conflict, the AskUser surfaces a follow-up write-back question after the user picks, to prevent conflict from persisting across runs
Proposer in v1 only watches command-pair patterns (run_start/run_end in metrics.jsonl); it does NOT auto-propose workflow.slug_confirm because AskUser responses are not yet recorded in metrics.jsonl
Stale routing-preference memory after config supersedes it: v1 emits memory_potentially_superseded warning; cleanup is a v2 concern
Memory entries missing required fields are logged as routing_preference_malformed events and treated as non-existent (no crash)
Resolver falls back to git rev-parse --show-toplevel for project_root when Z_HARNESS_PROJECT_ROOT is unset; treats all memories as global if outside a git repo
_run_startup_guards() raises SystemExit(2) at module load on registry inconsistency — always add new question_ids to both QUESTION_IDS and VALIDATORS
Multi-IDE export (Cursor/Codex/agy) does NOT carry the precheck; those paths fall back to raw AskUserQuestion; v2 concern
[Overnight gate] Z_HARNESS_ASK_ALL=1 + Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt both set causes exit 5 from resolve-question — not a soft error; scripts must not set both
[Overnight gate] Z_HARNESS_OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE_EFFECTIVE must be valid JSON; unparseable string causes full env layer skip (defaults still apply)
[Overnight gate] check-no-ask --question-id with an unregistered ID when NO_ASK=halt returns halt (fail-closed), not proceed
[Overnight gate] check-no-ask in policy mode returns unhandled_gate (not halt) for registered gates not on the frozen policy — a loud abort, not a silent block
[defer-to-sink] result==defer-to-sink must NOT be treated as skip — orchestrator must explicitly call scripts/sink-add.sh; absence of that call silently drops the discovery
[followup] Array-typed followup keys (path_allowlist, path_denylist, audit_evidence_required_artifacts) are not in VALIDATORS and receive no enum validation
[followup] auto_close_low_risk_enabled defaults to TRUE (on) — do not assume it is off by default
[followup] auto_close_low_risk_path_denylist last entry is '/*.md' (root-anchored) not '*.md'; a glob without leading slash would block docs/**/*.md entries which are in the allowlist
[followup] Z_HARNESS_NOTION_TOKEN is env-only; read by notion-push.py _resolve_token() before falling back to secrets.toml; callers must NOT run notion-push.py under set -x (token leaks into logs)

[active-plan] Z_HARNESS_REGISTRY_ENABLED, Z_HARNESS_REGISTRY_STALE_SECS, Z_HARNESS_STRICT_OVERLAP, Z_HARNESS_EXTERNAL_DEFAULT, Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR are NOT in ENV_ONLY_KNOBS and not surfaced by inspect-all; they are active-plan-registry env vars only
[brainstorm] brainstorm.personas = false only suppresses persona injection in /z-brainstorm; experiment.persona_rotation is a separate gate for implement/plan/debug rotation

workflow.audit_to_amend.description: Controls Phase 5 AskUserQuestion in /z-audit-plan and /z-audit-plan-style. ask=always prompt; amend=auto-proceed as amend (skips prompt); stop=auto-stop (skips prompt)

workflow.slug_confirm.description: Controls soft non-obvious-slug confirmation at 7 callsites. ask=always prompt; auto_accept=silently accept derived slug (resolver returns skip); recommend_derived=pre-select derived slug (resolver returns prefill). Collision check always runs unconditionally

workflow.implement_all_proceed.description: Controls halt-resolution gate in /z-implement-all. ask=always prompt; auto_resume=skip prompt; halt=stop unconditionally

workflow.review_all_proceed.description: Controls Phase 3.7 proceed gate in /z-review-all. ask=always prompt; proceed=skip prompt; halt=stop unconditionally

workflow.plan_decisions_approval.description: Controls Phase 2.5 decisions-doc approval gate in /z-plan. ask=always prompt; approve=skip prompt; halt=stop unconditionally

workflow.spec_retro_discovery.description: Controls how Phase 4 of /z-implement-next handles out-of-current-SPEC discoveries. ask=interactive prompt; defer_to_sink_p2=park as P2 follow-up in project sink (resolver returns defer-to-sink; orchestrator calls sink-add.sh)

axioms_section.description: Configuration for the axiom extraction pipeline and axiom resolver layer. Axioms are the lowest-precedence signal in resolve-question: they only fill gaps when config is at default AND memory is silent.

axioms.enabled.description: Master kill-switch for axiom participation. When false, _load_axiom_matches returns [] immediately and auto_extract_post_run is also suppressed.

axioms.kernel_budget_chars.description: Max characters of axiom text included in the context kernel passed to implementers/consultants. Must be a positive integer (>=1).

axioms.extract_min_recurrence.description: Minimum recurrence count before a behavioral pattern is auto-extracted as an axiom candidate. Must be a positive integer (>=1).

axioms.auto_extract_post_run.description: When true, runs the axiom extraction pipeline automatically at the end of each /z-* run. Set to false to disable automatic extraction.

resolver_precedence.agree: axiom value == already-resolved value; config/memory wins; axiom appended to sources[] only; no source/result change; NO nested axiom object
resolver_precedence.gap_fill: config at default AND memory silent; axiom fills the gap; source='axiom', strength='soft', axiom:{id, statement} nested object (no conflict key)
resolver_precedence.direct_conflict: higher layer set a different value; higher layer wins value/result/strength/rule_id; source='axiom_conflict'; axiom:{id, statement, conflict:true} nested object
resolver_precedence.no_match: envelope is byte-identical to pre-axiom result; axiom key is ABSENT entirely (R7 structural backward-compat)

followup_namespace.description: Configuration for the follow-up registry (notion-followup-sink). All keys live under the [followup] TOML section. Added in T003 and T017.

followup.default_sink.description: Which sink new entries go to when no explicit --sink= flag is passed to sink-add.sh

followup.notion_enabled.description: Enable one-way Notion push mirror. When false, Notion sync is skipped entirely.

followup.notion_database_id.description: Notion database ID for the follow-up mirror. Required when notion_enabled=true.

followup.notion_token_path.description: Path to TOML secrets file containing [notion].token. Mode 0600 required. Env override: Z_HARNESS_NOTION_TOKEN (env-only, read by notion-push.py _resolve_token() before secrets file lookup; not a TOML key).

followup.auto_close_low_risk_enabled.description: Master kill-switch for auto-close-low-risk path. DEFAULT IS TRUE (on). Set to false to disable. When false, auto_close_eligible entries still flow through verify but the ceiling never fires.

followup.auto_close_low_risk_path_allowl.description: Glob patterns for paths that are safe for auto-close. All touched paths must match. Default deliberately excludes commands/**, agents/**, and top-level *.md.

followup.auto_close_low_risk_path_denyli.description: Glob patterns that block auto-close regardless of allowlist. Denylist takes precedence. NOTE: last entry is '/*.md' (root-anchored, blocks top-level .md only) not '*.md' (any depth).

followup.staleness_commit_window.description: Commit distance (git rev-list --count capture_head..HEAD) above which staleness prompt fires at claim time.

followup.staleness_warn_days.description: Age in days after which a soft staleness warning is shown at claim time. Does not block.

followup.staleness_hard_dismiss_days.description: Age in days after which entries are auto-dismissed. 0 = disabled (default). Enable by setting a positive integer.

followup.audit_evidence_required_artifac.description: Named artifact kinds that must be present in an audit_evidence.json blob.

Z_HARNESS_NOTION_TOKEN.description: Notion API token override. When non-empty, bypasses followup.notion_token_path secrets file lookup entirely. Not a TOML key; not in DEFAULTS or VALIDATORS.
Z_HARNESS_NOTION_TOKEN.security: Never set under set -x; value would leak into terminal/log output.

active_plan_env_knobs.description: Env-only knobs for the external artifact base and active-plan registry. NOT in config.py DEFAULTS/VALIDATORS/ENV_ONLY_KNOBS. Consumed by scripts/plan-path.sh and scripts/active-plan-registry.py. inspect-all does NOT surface these.

Z_HARNESS_EXTERNAL_DEFAULT.description: Controls base fallback chain tiers 2-4. Unset or 1: external resolution active (XDG->HOME/.local/state->.git/z-harness->pwd). 0: opt-out, forces old in-repo $(pwd)/z-harness (tier 5 only).

Z_HARNESS_BASE_DIR.description: TRUE ESCAPE HATCH: explicit absolute base dir override; bypasses .z-harness-base anchor entirely. Must be absolute; non-absolute is a hard error.

Z_HARNESS_REGISTRY_ENABLED.description: Set to 0 to disable active-plan registry. When 0: register/heartbeat/update-scope/overlaps/reap/deregister are silent no-ops; list and session-id still allowed.

Z_HARNESS_REGISTRY_STALE_SECS.description: Seconds after which last_heartbeat is considered stale. Reaper deletes local dead pids at 2x this; marks remote/unknown hosts as stale at 1x (no delete).

Z_HARNESS_STRICT_OVERLAP.description: Set to 1 to enable blocking-overlap mode. explicit*explicit exact path match between two live runs -> exit 20 (hard halt). Default: advisory only (exit 10).

defer_to_sink_result.description: Resolver result value added alongside skip|prefill|ask|halt. When an AskUserQuestion callsite is registered as 'defer-to-sink', the resolver returns {result: 'defer-to-sink', default: ..., sources: [...]}. The orchestrator handler calls scripts/sink-add.sh with the question context to create a follow-up entry instead of presenting the question interactively.
defer_to_sink_result.use_case: Questions that are meaningful but where interactive prompt is unwanted (e.g., spec-retro discoveries in overnight mode or when context is stale). The question becomes a follow-up work item rather than a blocking gate.
defer_to_sink_result.orchestrator_handler: On result==defer-to-sink: call scripts/sink-add.sh --sink=<default_sink> --priority=P2 --name='<question-id> decision deferred' --recommended-command='/z-do "<question context>"' --source-artifact='<current plan artifact>' --cited-paths='<relevant paths>'; defaults: auto_close_eligible=false, safe_to_retry=false

env_vars.Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK: Set to 'halt' to activate overnight mode; any other value is a no-op
env_vars.Z_HARNESS_OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE_EFFECTIVE: JSON object {question_id: value}; merged over OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE_QIDS_DEFAULT; env wins on collision
env_vars.Z_HARNESS_ASK_ALL: Set to '1' to force all questions to ask; mutually exclusive with Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt (exit 5)

exit_codes.5: Z_HARNESS_ASK_ALL=1 and Z_HARNESS_NO_ASK=halt both set (config conflict)

overnight_gate.policy_mode: Active when NO_ASK=halt AND (OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE_EFFECTIVE or OVERNIGHT_AUTODECIDE) is non-empty. In policy mode check-no-ask returns unhandled_gate (not halt) for registered gates not on the frozen policy.

resolve_question_envelope.source: config | memory | axiom | axiom_conflict | conflict | none | override | overnight_allowlist | no_ask_halt
resolve_question_envelope.strength: hard | very_strong | strong | weak | soft | none | policy

axiom.id: <axiom id — present only on axiom/axiom_conflict outcomes>
axiom.conflict: <true only on axiom_conflict; absent on gap-fill>

sources.location: <config file path or docs/llm/*.json or env var name or axiom id>

routing_preference_memory_schema.description: Memory type for routing-class workflow preferences. Lives in docs/llm/workflow.json (global scope) or docs/llm/workflow-<project-slug>.json (project scope).

fields.project_root: <absolute path — required when scope is project; omit or null for global>

example.reason: Always amend after audit on this project

experiment_section.description: Feature-flag knobs for the persona-rotation data-collection experiment. All keys are on by default. Setting persona_rotation=false fully reverts all rotation behavior.

experiment.persona_rotation.description: Master on/off switch for persona rotation in z-implement-all, z-implement-next, z-plan, and z-debug. false = complete no-op.

experiment.control_every_n.description: Forced-control cadence: every Nth implementer attempt (repo-wide counter in .z-harness/.persona-control-counter) uses boring-anchor instead of random draw.

v2_deferrals: Stale-memory hygiene: when routing-preference memory exists and user later writes same question_id to config, v1 only warns (memory_potentially_superseded); v2 will add cleanup prompt or auto-archive
Async memory-write telemetry: propose_accepted event logged only after /z-suggest-memory returns 0
Multi-IDE export precheck integration: Cursor/Codex/agy fall back to raw AskUserQuestion in v1
Halt-class bypass (spec_problem, decision_needed): explicitly out of v1

brainstorm_section.description: Configuration for persona-diversity behavior in /z-brainstorm. Added alongside experiment.persona_rotation / experiment.control_every_n as the brainstorm-specific gate.

brainstorm.personas.description: When true (default), /z-brainstorm injects persona diversity when generating ideas. When false, brainstorm sessions run without persona injection. No-op for non-brainstorm commands.
